advisories.detail: The release-pinned GNUton changelog identifies the AiCloud fix in the 388.9_2 baseline used by this exact GNUton build. This documents the published fix, not verification of the installed binary.
The release-pinned baseline changelog records an OpenSSL backport before this build. No exploitation or installed-binary verification was performed.

A later GNUton baseline documents the OpenSSL fix. The upstream issue involves password-encrypted CMS processing. Component inclusion, reachable functionality and exploitability on this installed build are not established; review the later firmware release.

vendorEol.detail: ASUS lists both model variants as end-of-life only in the EU. This does not establish GNUton project support status or ASUS support outside that region.
